test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To which of the following states does Ramchandraiah, a Koya tribal singer, who received Padma Shri 2022, belong?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sakini Ramachandraiah, a vocal folk singer and musical instrument player**, was awarded Padma Shri by the President. 
 
• He is famous for for **'Kanchu melam-Kanchuthalam'** – a tribal art form related to to the **Koya people** in **Telangana and Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• This year's list terms **four Padma Vibhushan, 17 Padma Bhushan and 107 Padma Shri awards**.
 
• The awards are presented by **the President of India** at official functions which are organized at** Rashtrapati Bhawan.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards 2022:** **Sonu Nigam** accepts Padma Shri Award, Victor Banerjee awarded with Padma Bhushan.
 
• 2022 list terms **four Padma Vibhushan, 17 Padma Bhushan and 107 Padma Shri awards**. 
 
• Thirty four of the awardees are women and the list as well includes 10 people from the class of Foreigners, Non resident Indians and Overseas Citizens of India, apart from 13 posthumous awardees.
 
• In the middle of the the awardees are** Padma Vibhushan **receivers — **Radhey Shyam, former president of Gita Press, and General Bipin Rawat**. **Rawat died in a tragic chopper crash last year along with his wife and 11 others.**
